verdict.rationale: Greenhouse can be driven without its UI through documented APIs: you can update candidates, add attachments, and advance, move or reject applications. It also offers webhooks for application and candidate events and a developer sandbox, so scripted automation is plausible. However, nothing shows a CLI, CI integration guidance, or a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, which probes returned as 404. missing for 10: official CLI or headless runner, documented CI/automation workflows, OpenAPI spec, independent hands-on corroboration.
